home.heroSubtitle: Seasonal produce, candlelight and a kitchen worth booking a week ahead. Breakfast, dinner or a guest-chef night — pick your format.
home.conceptTitle: No pomp in the kitchen — but plenty of character
home.conceptQuote: Good food doesn't start at the stove, it starts in the field. We just try not to get in the produce's way.
home.conceptText1: Lumière opened in 2016 as a small project by a team of chefs in love with European cuisine. Today it's a restaurant people return to for birthdays, business meetings and ordinary Friday evenings.
home.conceptText2: We work with 18 farms around Moscow and rewrite the menu every season — the table only carries what genuinely tastes best right now.
home.menuSubtitle: Updated every quarter. A selection below; the full card and delivery live on their own page.
home.spaceTitle: Six rooms for the mood of the evening
home.formatsTitle: When you need more than dinner
home.loyaltyText: A free guest card: collect points and unlock private dinners before anyone else.

home.loyaltyPoint2: Early access to guest-chef and wine evenings
home.loyaltyPoint3: A compliment from the chef on your birthday
